title: The Llama 4 Herd: The Beginning of a New Era of Natively Multimodal AI Innovation
paper_type_zh: 前沿多模态模型技术报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 审计多模态训练与蒸馏披露边界的读者
one_line: Meta reports multimodal pretraining plus hard-example SFT, online RL, DPO, safety tuning, and Behemoth-to-Maverick codistillation for Llama 4, releases Scout/Maverick weights, and withholds the training records and core feedback stack.
Llama 4 Herd 报告了超过 30T 的多模态训练 token、200 种语言，以及 Behemoth 为 Scout 和 Maverick 提供教师能力；但数据清单和后训练反馈均为 unknown。
why: It lets the frontier-report ledger separate released model artifacts from unreleased multimodal data, difficulty labels, policy rollouts, preferences, rewards, and teacher targets, while preventing benchmark results from standing in for data evidence.
inclusion_reason: A high-impact frontier-family disclosure that names multimodal pretraining sources, model-specific token totals, hard-example filtering, SFT-online-RL-DPO stages, safety-data channels, and Behemoth-to-Maverick codistillation while leaving record-level data and reward contracts unavailable.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Llama 4 is relevant to a reasoning-data atlas because its official release describes several distinct objects that are easy to collapse: a multimodal pretraining mixture, specialized-data mid-training, hard-example SFT, online-RL prompts and policy outputs, DPO feedback, safety-tuning records, Behemoth distillation targets, released Scout/Maverick weights, and benchmark results. An auditable Card must keep those objects separate.

The official model cards report about 40T pretraining tokens for Scout and about 22T for Maverick. The launch report separately says the overall text-image-video mixture exceeds 30T and covers 200 pretraining languages. None of these aggregate figures is a corpus manifest. Likewise, downloadable weights and evaluation tables do not expose the examples, feedback records, reward functions, or source-level rights needed to reproduce or audit the training pipeline.

Llama 4 之所以适合进入推理数据图谱，不是因为它只代表一个模型家族，而是因为官方发布同时描述了多类容易被混为一谈的对象：多模态预训练混合、使用专门数据的 mid-training、困难样本 SFT、online RL 的提示与策略输出、DPO 反馈、安全微调记录、Behemoth 蒸馏目标、已发布的 Scout/Maverick 权重，以及 benchmark 结果。可审计的 Card 必须把这些对象分开。

官方模型卡分别报告 Scout 约 40T、Maverick 约 22T 的预训练 token；发布报告另称整体文本—图像—视频混合超过 30T，并覆盖 200 种预训练语言。这些总量都不是语料清单。类似地，可下载权重和评测表也没有公开复现或审计训练流水线所需的样本、反馈记录、奖励函数与来源级权利信息。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The most useful contribution is a partial construction ledger. Pretraining uses early fusion over text and vision, includes image and video data, and is followed by specialized-data mid-training. For Maverick, Meta reports lightweight SFT, multimodal online RL, and lightweight DPO. More than half of SFT data tagged easy by Llama judges is removed; during online RL, training alternates with policy-driven filtering that retains medium-to-hard prompts.

A separate teacher branch matters. Meta specifically documents codistilling Maverick from the still-unreleased Llama 4 Behemoth, using a loss that dynamically weights soft and hard targets. For most student data, targets are amortized through codistillation; fresh Behemoth forward passes generate targets for additional data. These are disclosed lineage operations, not released teacher traces.

The feedback contract is mixed but incomplete: Llama-based difficulty judgments, an undisclosed online-RL reward, undisclosed DPO feedback, safety classifiers, and teacher targets all affect selection or learning. The report does not release the judges, prompts, reward definition, preferences, or record schemas.

最有价值的贡献是一份不完整但具体的构造账本。预训练以 early fusion 统一文本与视觉，并纳入图像和视频数据；随后使用专门数据进行 mid-training。对于 Maverick，Meta 报告了 lightweight SFT、multimodal online RL 和 lightweight DPO。经 Llama 裁判标为简单的 SFT 数据中，超过一半被删除；online RL 期间则交替执行训练与策略驱动的过滤，只保留中等至困难提示。

另一条教师分支必须单独记录。Meta 明确说明 Maverick 由仍未发布的 Llama 4 Behemoth codistill 而来，蒸馏损失在训练中动态加权 soft target 与 hard target。大部分学生数据通过 codistillation 摊销目标计算；对于新增数据，再运行 Behemoth forward pass 生成目标。这些是已披露的谱系操作，不是已发布的教师轨迹。

反馈合同属于 mixed，但并不完整：Llama 难度判断、未披露的 online-RL 奖励、未披露的 DPO 反馈、安全分类器与教师目标都会影响筛选或学习。报告没有发布裁判、提示、奖励定义、偏好记录或样本 schema。

title: Method
方法
html:
Official model cards say pretraining draws on publicly available and licensed data plus information from Meta products and services, including publicly shared Instagram and Facebook posts and interactions with Meta AI. The models use early-fusion multimodality; the vision encoder is based on MetaCLIP and is trained separately with a frozen Llama model. Meta also reports MetaP hyperparameter transfer, FP8 training, 200 pretraining languages, and specialized-data mid-training for long context. Source inventories, modality proportions, filters, and split membership are unknown.

Maverick post-training uses a curated multimodal curriculum: remove more than 50% of SFT examples judged easy by Llama models, run lightweight SFT on the harder remainder, apply online RL to harder prompts, alternate training with continuous filtering for medium-to-hard prompts, and finish with lightweight DPO for response-quality corner cases. The report does not name the SFT authors, judge checkpoint, RL algorithm or reward, rollout count, DPO preference source, thresholds, or optimizer settings.

Behemoth is a separate branch. Its post-training prunes 95% of SFT data, uses policy pass@k to build an increasingly hard curriculum, filters zero-advantage prompts, mixes capabilities in batches, varies system instructions, and uses fully asynchronous online RL. Only the Behemoth-to-Maverick codistillation relation is explicit for a released model; these Behemoth post-training settings must not be generalized to Scout or Maverick. Safety tuning separately combines vendor-generated human data and synthetic data selected with LLM-based classifiers, but the records and selection models are not released.

官方模型卡称，预训练数据来自公开可得数据、许可数据以及 Meta 产品与服务中的信息，其中包括 Instagram 和 Facebook 上公开分享的帖子，以及用户与 Meta AI 的交互。模型采用 early-fusion multimodality；视觉编码器基于 MetaCLIP，并在冻结的 Llama 模型配合下单独训练。Meta 还报告了 MetaP 超参数迁移、FP8 训练、200 种预训练语言，以及面向长上下文的专门数据 mid-training。来源清单、模态比例、过滤规则和 split 成员均为 unknown。

Maverick 后训练采用精心筛选的多模态 curriculum：先由 Llama 模型判定难度并删除超过 50% 的简单 SFT 样本，在剩余困难样本上进行 lightweight SFT；随后对困难提示执行 online RL，并在训练与持续过滤之间交替，只保留中等至困难提示；最后以 lightweight DPO 处理响应质量的边角案例。报告没有给出 SFT 作者、裁判 checkpoint、RL 算法或奖励、rollout 数量、DPO 偏好来源、阈值或优化器设置。

Behemoth 属于另一条分支。其后训练会裁掉 95% 的 SFT 数据，使用策略模型的 pass@k 构建难度递增 curriculum，过滤 zero-advantage 提示，在 batch 中混合多种能力，并采样不同 system instruction，底层采用 fully asynchronous online RL。对于已发布模型，只有 Behemoth 到 Maverick 的 codistillation 关系得到明确说明；这些 Behemoth 设置不能泛化到 Scout 或 Maverick。安全微调另行结合 vendor 生成的人类数据与合成数据，并用 LLM 分类器筛选，但记录和筛选模型没有发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official Meta release report supports the early-fusion pretraining, more-than-30T overall mixture, 200-language coverage, specialized-data mid-training, Maverick SFT-online-RL-DPO sequence, greater-than-50% easy-data removal, continuous difficulty filtering, Behemoth codistillation, and the distinct Behemoth post-training recipe. It also says Behemoth was still training and not released.

The official Maverick model card and Scout model card identify the public/licensed/Meta-product source classes, about 22T and 40T model-specific token totals, August 2024 cutoff, 12 supported languages, custom Llama 4 Community License, and released model characteristics. The official Llama 4 collection confirms base and instruction-tuned Scout/Maverick weight releases; the meta-llama repository supplies inference and license materials.

These artifacts do not release the training corpus, SFT/RL/DPO records, Behemoth targets, difficulty labels, reward stack, judge implementations, or split manifests. Benchmark tables therefore evidence reported model behavior under evaluation protocols, not the quality, provenance, or reproducibility of the hidden training data.

官方 Meta 发布报告支持以下披露：early-fusion 预训练、超过 30T 的整体混合、200 种语言覆盖、使用专门数据的 mid-training、Maverick 的 SFT—online RL—DPO 顺序、删除超过 50% 的简单数据、持续难度过滤、Behemoth codistillation，以及彼此独立的 Behemoth 后训练配方。报告还明确说明 Behemoth 当时仍在训练且没有发布。

官方 Maverick 模型卡与 Scout 模型卡确认了公开/许可/Meta 产品数据来源类别、约 22T 与 40T 的模型级 token 总量、2024 年 8 月 cutoff、12 种受支持语言、自定义 Llama 4 Community License 和模型特征。官方 Llama 4 collection确认 base 与 instruction-tuned Scout/Maverick 权重已经发布；meta-llama repository提供推理与许可材料。

这些产物没有发布训练语料、SFT/RL/DPO 记录、Behemoth 目标、难度标签、奖励栈、裁判实现或 split 清单。因此，benchmark 表只能证明官方报告的模型在相应评测协议下呈现了某些行为，不能证明隐藏训练数据的质量、来源或可复现性。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
For the frontier-report disclosure ledger, Llama 4 is useful because it exposes selection logic rather than only naming optimization stages. The report connects difficulty labels to two concrete operations: removing more than half of Maverick's easy SFT data and repeatedly filtering online-RL prompts to medium-to-hard difficulty. It also separates teacher-target construction from post-training by describing Behemoth-to-Maverick codistillation during pretraining.

The careful comparison is internal, not promotional. Released Scout/Maverick weights, a still-unreleased Behemoth teacher, model-specific pretraining totals, a family-level mixture statement, post-training stages, and evaluation results are different evidence types. The novelty for this Card is the auditable separation of those layers and of Maverick versus Behemoth workflows. It is not a claim that Llama 4 introduced SFT, RL, DPO, distillation, model-as-judge filtering, or multimodal training.

对于“前沿报告与数据披露账本”，Llama 4 的价值在于它不仅列出优化阶段，还披露了部分筛选逻辑。报告把难度标签连接到两个具体操作：删除 Maverick 超过一半的简单 SFT 数据，以及在 online RL 中反复把提示过滤到中等至困难区间。它还通过描述预训练阶段的 Behemoth-to-Maverick codistillation，把教师目标构造与后训练区分开来。

这里需要做的是内部证据比较，而不是宣传。已发布的 Scout/Maverick 权重、仍未发布的 Behemoth 教师、模型级预训练 token 总量、家族级混合说明、后训练阶段和评测结果属于不同证据类型。本 Card 的新意是可审计地拆开这些层，并区分 Maverick 与 Behemoth 的工作流；它并不声称 Llama 4 首创了 SFT、RL、DPO、蒸馏、model-as-judge 过滤或多模态训练。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
No checked official artifact provides a training-record manifest, source-level counts or mixture weights, modality allocation, collection dates, per-record provenance, train/evaluation membership, decontamination procedure, or redistribution terms for the corpus. The model cards name broad source classes, including interactions with Meta AI, but do not expose item-level rights or consent context.

For Maverick post-training, the SFT set size and authors, difficulty-judge identity and prompt, acceptance thresholds, online-RL objective and reward, rollout settings, DPO preference source, and optimization hyperparameters are unknown. For codistillation, Behemoth targets, target schema, weighting schedule, and record-to-checkpoint lineage are unavailable. Safety human/synthetic records and LLM classifiers are also unreleased.

The 200-language pretraining claim is broader than the 12 languages supported in the model cards. Scout's released 10M context specification relies on length generalization from 256K pre- and post-training; it does not establish 10M-token training records. The April 2025 report says Behemoth was still training and unreleased. Finally, no benchmark result establishes that the hidden training records are accurate, representative, uncontaminated, or legally reusable.

已核查的官方产物均未提供训练记录清单、来源级计数或混合权重、模态分配、采集日期、样本级 provenance、训练/评测成员关系、decontamination 程序或语料再分发条款。模型卡只列出宽泛来源类别，其中包括与 Meta AI 的交互，却没有公开样本级权利与同意语境。

对于 Maverick 后训练，SFT 集规模与作者、难度裁判身份与提示、接收阈值、online-RL 目标与奖励、rollout 设置、DPO 偏好来源和优化超参数都是 unknown。对于 codistillation，Behemoth 目标、目标 schema、加权日程以及样本到 checkpoint 的谱系均不可得。安全微调的人类/合成记录和 LLM 分类器同样没有发布。

200 种预训练语言的陈述宽于模型卡明确支持的 12 种语言。Scout 发布的 10M context 规格依赖从 256K pre- and post-training 得到的 length generalization，不能据此断言存在 10M-token 训练记录。2025 年 4 月的报告称 Behemoth 仍在训练且未发布。最后，任何 benchmark 结果都不能证明隐藏训练记录准确、有代表性、无污染或可合法复用。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Within the frontier reports and data-disclosure ledger track, this Card supports branch-aware auditing. A curator can separately record pretraining sources and totals, mid-training, Maverick's hard-example SFT-online-RL-DPO pipeline, Behemoth-to-Maverick teacher targets, Behemoth's own post-training curriculum, safety data, released weights, and evaluation-only evidence.

For post-training reasoning-data work, the disclosed difficulty filters are useful design signals: judge-labeled easy-example removal and continuous medium-to-hard prompt selection show where data selection enters optimization. They are not reusable recipes without the prompts, judge, thresholds, rewards, and rollout settings. The codistillation description likewise establishes a teacher relationship and target-generation path but not an open trace dataset.

The Card can therefore be used to compare Llama 4 with reports that release training records, verifiers, preferences, or reward code. It should not be used to label the Llama 4 corpus as open, the online RL as reproducible RLVR, Behemoth methods as Scout/Maverick methods, or benchmark performance as data-quality evidence.

在“前沿报告与数据披露账本”轨道中，本 Card 支持按分支审计。策展者可以分别记录预训练来源与总量、mid-training、Maverick 的困难样本 SFT—online RL—DPO 流水线、Behemoth-to-Maverick 教师目标、Behemoth 自身的后训练 curriculum、安全数据、已发布权重和仅用于评测的证据。

对于后训练推理数据研究，已披露的难度过滤具有设计参考价值：由裁判标注并删除简单样本，以及持续选择中等至困难提示，说明数据选择具体进入优化流程的位置。但缺少提示、裁判、阈值、奖励和 rollout 设置时，它们并不是可复用配方。codistillation 描述同样只能确认教师关系和目标生成路径，不能证明存在开放的 trace 数据集。

因此，本 Card 可用来把 Llama 4 与公开训练记录、verifier、偏好或奖励代码的报告进行比较。它不能用于把 Llama 4 语料标为开放数据、把 online RL 标为可复现 RLVR、把 Behemoth 方法归给 Scout/Maverick，或把 benchmark 性能当作数据质量证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read the official report's pretraining and mid-training paragraphs before using any token count; model cards give about 40T for Scout and 22T for Maverick, while the report separately states an overall mixture above 30T.
  • Follow the Maverick post-training sequence in order: remove more than 50% easy-tagged SFT data, lightweight SFT, harder-prompt online RL with continuous filtering, then lightweight DPO.
  • Keep Behemoth on a separate branch: its 95% SFT pruning, pass@k curriculum, zero-advantage filtering, and asynchronous RL are not documented as Scout/Maverick procedures.
  • Treat Behemoth-to-Maverick codistillation as a disclosed target-generation lineage, not as a release of teacher outputs or traces.
  • Use the official Hugging Face collection as evidence for released weights and model cards, not for released training data; read benchmark tables only as evaluation evidence.

• 使用任何 token 总量前，先读官方报告的 pretraining 与 mid-training 段落：模型卡分别给出 Scout 约 40T、Maverick 约 22T，报告则另称整体混合超过 30T。
  • 按顺序阅读 Maverick 后训练：删除超过 50% 的简单 SFT 数据、lightweight SFT、带持续过滤的困难提示 online RL，最后是 lightweight DPO。
  • 把 Behemoth 保持为独立分支：95% SFT 裁剪、pass@k curriculum、zero-advantage 过滤和 asynchronous RL 均未被说明为 Scout/Maverick 流程。
  • 把 Behemoth-to-Maverick codistillation 视为已披露的目标生成谱系，而不是教师输出或 trace 已发布。
  • 官方 Hugging Face collection 只能证明权重与模型卡已发布，不能证明训练数据已发布；benchmark 表也只能作为评测证据阅读。

value_zh.html: 对 Maverick，Llama 评审模型标记为 easy 的 SFT 数据超过 50% 被移除；在线 RL 交替训练与过滤以保留中到难提示，随后以轻量 DPO 处理响应质量边角案例。Behemoth 单独剪除 95% 的 SFT 数据并过滤零优势提示。

value.html: Scout is pre- and post-trained at 256K context and is released with a claimed 10M input context through length generalization; Maverick is listed at 1M context. These context specifications are not online-RL rollout budgets, which remain unknown.

value_zh.html: Scout 在 256K 上下文上预训与训后，并经长度泛化以声称的 10M 输入上下文发布；Maverick 列为 1M 上下文。这些上下文规格不是在线 RL 的 rollout 预算，后者仍未知。

value.html: The disclosed family pipeline is pretraining, specialized-data mid-training, then lightweight SFT, online RL, and lightweight DPO for Maverick. Behemoth uses lightweight SFT followed by large-scale asynchronous online RL. RL objectives, optimizer settings, reward coefficients, and checkpoint schedules are unknown.

value_zh.html: 所披露的模型族流水线为预训练、专用数据 mid-training，然后对 Maverick 进行轻量 SFT、在线 RL 与轻量 DPO。Behemoth 使用轻量 SFT 后接大规模异步在线 RL。RL 目标、优化器设置、奖励系数与 checkpoint 日程未知。

value.html: Official model cards report about 40T multimodal pretraining tokens for Scout and about 22T for Maverick, from public, licensed, and Meta product/service information; the launch report separately describes an overall text-image-video mixture above 30T. No source manifest, per-source count, mixture weight, collection window, or item-level provenance is released.

value_zh.html: 官方模型卡片报告 Scout 约 40T 多模态预训练 token、Maverick 约 22T，来自公开、已许可与 Meta 产品/服务信息；发布报告另行描述总体文本-图像-视频混合物超过 30T。未发布来源清单、逐来源计数、混合物权重、收集窗口或条目级出处。

items: Released weights and inference code do not constitute a release of the pretraining, SFT, online-RL, DPO, distillation, or safety-training records.
The 200-language pretraining statement must not be confused with the 12 languages explicitly supported by the model cards.
Scout's 10M context claim comes from length generalization after 256K pre- and post-training and is not evidence for 10M-token training examples.
Behemoth's pass@k curriculum, 95% SFT pruning, zero-advantage filtering, and asynchronous RL are a separate branch and must not be silently assigned to the released models.
The RL reward, DPO preference source, judge versions, filtering thresholds, split policy, and decontamination procedure are undisclosed.
Reported benchmark performance measures model behavior under stated evaluations; it does not establish training-data quality, provenance, legality, or reproducibility.
已发布权重与推理代码不构成预训练、SFT、在线 RL、DPO、蒸馏或安全训练记录的发布。
200 种语言的预训练陈述不得与模型卡片明确支持的 12 种语言混淆。
Scout 的 10M 上下文主张来自 256K 预训与训后之后的长度泛化，并非 10M-token 训练样例的证据。
Behemoth 的 pass@k 课程、95% SFT 剪除、零优势过滤与异步 RL 为单独分支，不得静默归于已发布模型。
RL 奖励、DPO 偏好来源、评审模型版本、过滤阈值、划分策略与去污染程序未披露。
所报告基准表现度量所述评测下的模型行为；不确立训练数据质量、出处、合法性或可复现性。

value.html: Released model weights and repository materials use the custom Llama 4 Community License, not a general open-data license. The underlying training corpus is not released, and source-level rights, consent context, and redistribution terms cannot be audited from the checked artifacts.
